question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

Roads in villages during rainy seasons become __muddy.__
solution:
The correct answer is** **'**filthy**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**muddy**' is '**filthy**'.
 
• **Muddy**: covered or filled with mud, dirt, or grime. *In Hindi: गंदा, कीचड़ीला, मैला*
 
 
• *Example: I can't wear my new shoes today because the streets are so **muddy.***
 
 
 
• **Filthy**: disgustingly dirty. *In Hindi: गंदा*
 
 
• *Example: The kitchen was so **filthy** that I had to clean it for hours before I could cook in there.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Filthy.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Fuzzy** - unclear, indistinct, or lacking in detail. *In Hindi: अस्पष्ट, धुंधला, अनिश्चित*
 
• **Blurred** - not clear or sharply defined. *In Hindi: धुंधला, अस्पष्ट, कलहंस*
 
• **Unsoiled** - clean, not stained or contaminated. *In Hindi: स्वच्छ, अपवित्र न हुआ, निष्कलंक *
